topic: Global electric-vehicle share of new car sales

source.name: International Energy Agency — Global EV Outlook 2024
source.excerpt: Electric cars accounted for around 18% of all cars sold in 2023, up from about 14% in 2022.

claims.claim: Electric vehicles made up 18% of global car sales.

source.name: BloombergNEF — Electric Vehicle Outlook 2023
source.excerpt: Battery-electric and plug-in hybrid vehicles reached 14% of global passenger-vehicle sales.

claims.claim: Electric vehicles reached 14% of global passenger-vehicle sales.
